mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fx_rates (pair, rate_date, rate, quote_as_of, fetched_on) VALUES (#{pair}, (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date, #{rate}, #{quoteAsOf}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (pair, rate_date) DO UPDATE SET rate = EXCLUDED.rate, quote_as_of = EXCLUDED.quote_as_of, fetched_on = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fx_rates WHERE rate_date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
